name: Timidity
overview: Scripture teaches that timidity and fear are overcome through the strength and courage given by the Lord, who is always present with His people (Joshua 1:9; Ephesians 6:10). Believers are called to reject fear because they have received the Spirit of adoption, which frees them from bondage and enables them to approach God confidently as Father (Romans 8:15). The peace of Christ calms troubled hearts and removes fear, empowering believers to stand firm and overcome trials by the blood of the Lamb and the testimony of their faith (John 14:27; Revelation 12:11). Thus, true courage arises from trusting in God's presence, power, and redemptive work in Christ.
